verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA DGX/HGX B200 is on-premises GPU server hardware that the customer operates, not a hosted AI service that ingests customer data. A vendor training-data opt-out control is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product collecting customer data for model training or offering such a control. The air-gapped NIM deployment mention is adjacent deployment guidance, not a training-data opt-out, so it does not make this axis apply.
